name: Grimlock Bodyguard
tactics: A grimlock bodyguard focuses its attacks on well-armored foes, particularly strikers and defenders. A bodyguard stays in constant motion with stick and shift and bodyguard shift, counting on its guarded mark and mindlash to draw enemy attacks away from its allies.

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

traits.name: Bodyguard Shift
traits.details: When the grimlock shifts no more than 1 square, it can slide an adjacent enemy marked by it 1 square and shift into the square the enemy vacated.

traits.name: Guarded Mark
traits.details: Any enemy that ends its turn adjacent to the grimlock is marked by the grimlock until the end of the enemy’s next turn. Any enemy marked by the grimlock cannot gain combat advantage by flanking any grimlock bodyguard.

effect.description: The grimlock uses greatsword, then shifts 1 square.

powers.name: Mindlash
powers.trigger: An enemy within 5 squares of and marked by the grimlock makes an attack that does not include the grimlock as a target.

effect.description: Close burst 5 (the triggering enemy); 10 psychic damage.
